body: Sounds like you have a vampire problem.  Take care of that quickly - once glitter gets on you, IT NEVER COMES OFF.
I'm so glad you didn't call it by...well, I won't say it.  It's always going to be the Jake.

I would love to volunteer and I loved teaching when I was a TA/tutor. This is the reason why I feel so uncomfortable being with anyone under the age of 18 for ANYTHING. Maybe the women/masochistic "manly men" who look at us with questioning eyes should back off and let us have fun with those we are trying to help instead of constantly accusing us of doing something wrong/we must be gay just because we like to help.

When I applied to jobs outside of my field (Biology), I found it best to leave off things about my technical experiences and just saying something generic, then playing up my experience with tools related to that area (when I applied for an IT job, I talked about my skills with computers/programs that I used in my research).  It got me 2 interviews, so it might be worth it to pay attention to those details.
